record.question: There are __________ types of Plane Tabling.
record.explanation: The four conventional plane-table methods are radiation, intersection, resection and traversing. Thus four is the curriculum count intended by the printed blank. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/Curriculum/CTS/English/Surveyor.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
